title: Struktura DFA
description: Detrended Fluctuation Analysis (DFA) anomaly detection. Computes windowed DFA scaling exponents and scores deviations from a self-calibrated baseline. Zero training, zero hyperparameter tuning. The first Rust algorithm in this benchmark.

parameters.name: window_size
parameters.description: DFA window size in samples. Must be >= 64.

parameters.name: step_size
parameters.description: Sliding window step size in samples.

parameters.name: threshold
parameters.description: Baseline noise floor for the score denominator.
